results.title: L’imaginifico. Gabriele d’Annunzio
results.overview: “The palace is empty. Fiume is without music.” With these words, in January 1921, Gabriele d’Annunzio bids farewell forever to the “city of life” and begins the final chapter of his existence. He retreats to Gardone Riviera, to the “Vittoriale degli Italiani,” where he will spend the last seventeen years of his life, transforming his home into a work of art and a place destined to preserve his memory. With Adriano Giannini as the narrator, the film takes us into a world-house where every room and every object reflects the personality and obsessions of its creator. The words of the Vate, drawn from his writings and correspondence, intertwine with contributions from scholars and artists, offering new perspectives on his figure and his cultural legacy.

results.title: Fat
results.overview: A father obsessed with his own physique decides to force his overweight son to slim down, to the point of no return.

results.title: In This Room
results.overview: In a world that seems to be falling apart, poetry, empathy, and music remind us of the urgent need to understand one another. Through fado and the distinctive voice of its most famous singer, Carminho, a glimmer of hope emerges across the landscapes of a Japan once devastated by bombings. The film follows the Portuguese artist on tour across the country. Through concerts, backstage moments, hotel rooms, taxis, silences, and whispers, the film weaves together the world of fado and Japan’s cultural landscape.

results.title: Memory Box
results.overview: The film follows a teenage boy as he packs up his childhood bedroom, preparing to leave behind an important part of his life. As he comes across different objects, he is reminded of memories from his childhood and teenage years, with each memory representing a different emotion and experience that has shaped who he is.  The film explores themes of growing up, nostalgia, family, friendship, and the difficult emotions that come with change. It is a Bildungsroman, as the story focuses on the boy’s personal and emotional development as he reflects on his past and begins to understand how his experiences have shaped the person he is becoming. Ultimately, the film is about leaving childhood behind while recognising that those experiences will always remain a part of him.

results.title: Conscience
results.overview: The filmmakers present the stories of ordinary people across three segments of this anthology film: "Trust," "Frenzy," and "Conscience." The lives of the protagonists have been ruthlessly ground down by a modern-day scourge: fraud.  Much is said and written today about the complex world of information technology and the importance of protecting oneself and one’s loved ones. Yet, not everyone possesses the caution, skepticism, wariness, and high level of awareness needed to stay safe; consequently, people of all ages and social backgrounds fall prey to scammers.
